subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Summer Picnic
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that our Annual Summer Picnic will be held on Saturday, August 15th at Central Park. Join us for a day of fun, games, and delicious food! Please RSVP by Friday, August 7th so we can make necessary arrangements. We look forward to spending a great day together as a team. Best regards, [Company Name]
